yt_title: 3 saved reels that lied to me
caption:
3 saved reels that lied to me:
3. "Run 100 AI agents at once": you'll hit your usage limit fast
2. "Secret AI mode": not a feature, it's a prompt
1. "$1000 a day dropshipping": the best case, most stores make way less

SaveSort flagged 10 of my 156 saves as be careful.

Download your Instagram data (Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Some of your information → Saved → HTML), then drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Sort yours free, link in bio.

#savedreels #instagramtips #productivity #aitools

beats.vo: 3 saved reels that lied to me. Number 1 is the worst.
